name: Safety First
summary: Razzeric has found that Shreev left the safety on the seaforium booster. It caps the power Razzeric gets out of the booster, and Razzeric had asked for it to be taken off. You are sent to Shreev in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris.

sections.title: A Safety Nobody Wanted
sections.body: Razzeric looks over the seaforium booster and finds the safety still on. It caps the power the booster can give, and Razzeric had told Shreev it should be off. Razzeric gives you the booster and sends you south of the Shimmering Flats into the Tanaris desert, to the Gadgetzan Gizmorium, to have Shreev remove the safety.

sections.title: Shreev's Answer
sections.body: The Gizmorium offers to service all of your tinkering needs. When you hand over the booster, Shreev denies putting any safety lock on it. By Shreev's account the booster is almost entirely seaforium explosive, already altered so more of its payload is delivered when used. Razzeric, Shreev says, is never content unless he goes all the way to eleven.

faq.answer: Razzeric, the goblin pilot, sends you to Gadgetzan with his seaforium booster.

faq.q: Why is Razzeric unhappy with the booster?
aliases: what is wrong with the booster
faq.answer: Shreev left the safety on. It caps the power Razzeric gets out of the booster, and Razzeric had asked for it to be removed.
Shreev is in Gadgetzan, at the Gizmorium, out in the Tanaris desert south of the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: What item are you carrying to Gadgetzan?
aliases: what do you bring to shreev
faq.answer: You carry Razzeric's seaforium booster, which Razzeric gives you to bring to Shreev.
The chain continues with a second part, also called Safety First.
